sentences.en: The bronze armor was useless against the Saxons' relentless attack.
sentences.zh: 那件青铜盔甲在撒克逊人的猛烈攻击下毫无用处。

sentences.en: A Bronze Age shipwreck was found in the Mediterranean sea.
sentences.zh: 地中海发现了一艘青铜时代的沉船。

sentences.en: The bronze statue looks quite nice from a distance.
sentences.zh: 从远处看，这座青铜雕像相当不错。
